answer: By the hollow of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts split across independent auditors. Every claim climbs the haven of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the ocean re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a concise reports, one example per claim register, it stays short.
